name: Effective Range / Dual Littlestone Dimension (affine)
details: For every finite binary class, $\mathrm E(\mathcal H)\ge\mathrm L^*(\mathcal H)-1$.
proof: In the dual class, nonconstant coordinate functions are indexed by effective coordinates, and there are at most two additional constant functions. A depth-d shattered tree needs $2^d$ distinct dual concepts, hence $2^d\le\mathrm E+2$. This implies $d\le\mathrm E+1$.
witness_verification: For half-intervals, effective range is $n$ whereas $\mathrm L^*=\Theta(\log n)$.
